planTitle: Claude Certified — Associate then Developer Foundations
planSubtitle: 15 days, 4 hours a day. Every course, quiz, and exam linked below.

phases.title: Associate Foundations
phases.goal: Get the entry-level certification done fast — non-technical, prompting and workflow focused.

items.t: Claude 101 — course (12 lectures, ~1 hr video)
AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations — course (14 lectures, 1.1 hr video)
Hands-on: configure a Project with a knowledge source in claude.ai
Review CCAO-F exam domains (prompting, output evaluation, model selection, workflow integration, responsible use)
AI Capabilities and Limitations — course (13 lectures, 15 min video)
Timed mock exam — 60 Q / 120 min, review every miss
Sit the Claude Certified Associate — Foundations exam

phases.title: Developer Foundations — prerequisites
phases.goal: Every official prerequisite course, in the order that builds on itself.

items.t: Finish local dev setup (Node, TypeScript SDK, API key, test script)
Claude Code 101 — course (12 lectures, 1 hr video)
Introduction to agent skills — course (6 lectures, 30 min video)
Introduction to subagents — course (4 lectures, 20 min video)
Claude Code in Action — course (15 lectures, 1 hr video, 1 quiz)
Hands-on: refactor a real script + add tests + try subagents
Claude Platform 101 — course home
Lesson: What is the Claude Developer Platform? / Your first API call / Choosing the right model
Lesson: The agent loop explained + What is tool use
Hands-on: build the agent loop by hand (no SDK Tool Runner yet)
Lesson: What is thinking (extended thinking)
Lesson: Built-in tools (web search, code execution, web fetch)
Hands-on: wire built-in tools into your test script
Lesson: Skills + Context management
Lesson: What are managed agents? + Building your first managed agent
Lesson: Building with Claude Code (standalone lesson)
Claude Platform 101 Quiz

days.title: Building with the Claude API — part 1 of 3

items.t: Building with the Claude API — course (84 lectures, 8.1 hr video, 10 quizzes)
Work first third: request/response structure, streaming, system prompts, multi-turn, vision/documents — do every demo yourself

days.title: Building with the Claude API — part 2 of 3

items.t: Middle third: tool use in depth, structured outputs, extended thinking params, prompt caching, batch processing
Focus: token/cost management, workspaces, limits, Console Workbench

days.title: Building with the Claude API — part 3 of 3

items.t: Final third: evals, guardrails, production patterns, deployment
Complete all 10 module quizzes, log weak areas
Introduction to Model Context Protocol — course (16 lectures, 1 hr video, 1 quiz)
Hands-on: build a simple MCP server + client from scratch in Python
Model Context Protocol: Advanced Topics — course (15 lectures, 1.1 hr video, 2 quizzes)
Hands-on: extend your MCP server with resources/prompts, test with Claude Code as client
Re-run any rushed demo from Days 8–10 (API course is dense)
Build one end-to-end project: tool use + MCP + a managed-agent-style loop
Review all quiz scores across the 6 prerequisite courses, list weak domains

phases.title: Exam readiness
phases.goal: Mock exams, targeted review, then the real thing.

items.t: Full timed mock exam for Developer Foundations, review every wrong answer
Second mock exam focused on weak domains
Re-watch only the specific weak-domain lecture segments
Skim personal notes across all 9 courses
Sanity-check dev environment: agent loop, tool schemas, MCP primitives
Light warm-up: 15–20 practice questions, no new material
Sit the Claude Certified Developer — Foundations exam
